title: Healthy and well packed
detail: Arrived upright with damp compost and no broken leaves.

title: Smaller than expected
detail: Healthy plant but a smaller pot than I thought. Check the pot size.

title: Sharp and solid
detail: The tool is heavy in a good way and came sharp.

title: Replaced without fuss
detail: One plant failed. Photo sent, new one in three days.

title: Flowered in three weeks
detail: Planted it on a Sunday, first bud by month end.

title: Terracotta is thick
detail: Proper fired clay, not the thin stuff. Survived a frost.

title: Seeds all came up
detail: Twenty sown, nineteen seedlings. Cannot ask for more.

title: Soil was dry on arrival
detail: Plant bounced back after a soak, but the box sat somewhere warm.

title: Handle fits the hand
detail: Ash handle, no blisters after an afternoon of digging.

title: Bees love it
detail: Covered in bees within a week of planting.

title: Wrong colour
detail: Ordered white, got pink. Beautiful, but not what I ordered. Refund given.

title: Hardy as promised
detail: Left out all winter in a pot and it came back.

title: Good starter set
detail: Everything a first garden needs and nothing it does not.

title: Watering can pours well
detail: Long spout, fine rose, no dribble down the side.

title: Delivery was gentle
detail: The courier carried it upright. The driver deserves the credit.

title: Herbs on the sill
detail: Six pots on the kitchen sill and I have not bought parsley since.

title: Compost smells right
detail: Dark and crumbly. My tomatoes doubled in a month.

title: Pot has no drainage hole
detail: Lovely glaze but no hole. Drill it or use it indoors with gravel.

title: Pruners cut clean
detail: Bypass blades, no crushing. Roses thanked me.

title: Bigger than the photo
detail: A three year old plant, not a plug. Delighted.

title: Label was helpful
detail: Planting depth, spacing and sun on the tag. Saved a search.

title: Gloves are tough
detail: Thorns did not get through. Fit is snug.

title: Slow to establish
detail: Took a full season to settle. Now it is the best thing in the border.

title: Bulbs came in paper
detail: No plastic in the box at all. Every bulb sprouted.

title: Trellis went up in an hour
detail: Cedar, pre-drilled, and the screws were in the box.
